declared_limitations.statement: Epic 11's certification is self-administered: written and executed by the same party that implemented Epic 11 (ADR-0051 CE9). No independent auditor reviewed these controls.

Every structural and behavioural control here is hermetic. No control executed a live Deepgram, Groq or Cartesia call, and none exercised a real WebRTC peer. Provider certification is therefore structural and hermetic, never live (R-54, R-58, R-63).

The I1 baseline E11-12 reads was produced with deterministic in-process providers and no network. It measures the runtime's own cost, not a conversation with a vendor, and the stt stage is structurally unmeasurable in the current turn shape (R-66).
No Stage-2 host is provisioned, so E11-15's evidence was never produced. This is an absence of evidence recorded as such, not a defect discovered and not a risk accepted.
